text:
trent: Starting coordinated region split for v3.0.0-alpha: US->EU->APAC. Window: US 01:00-03:00 UTC, EU 04:00-06:00 UTC, APAC 08:00-10:00 UTC. tagging @nina @ash for capacity sanity checks.
nina: got it. i'll validate reserved warm pools and thermal headroom for each region. current US pool spare=22%, EU spare=16%, APAC spare=14% (conservative).
ash: we should run a staged traffic shape: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% per region with 15m observation gates between steps. rollback triggers set as p95_delta>120ms OR errors>0.8% OR gpu-oom>0.
lina: also add a cache-warmup gate: require prefix-cache_hit >=85% before moving beyond 10%. last rollout failed because apac started with 60% cache_hit and dropped to 50%.
trent: agreed. plan: US starts now with 2% traffic for 15m. command: `/deploy start --region us --version v3.0.0-alpha --slice us-1 --pct 2 --gate 15m --warmup 3m`
deploy-bot: received `/deploy start` from trent, action id=act-7c3. Initiating gradual shift. Will report at gate intervals.
opsbot: preflight summary: us-pool-1 avg_cpu=68% spare=22% gpu_temp_avg=72C queue_len=2 prefix_cache_hit=89%
nina: US looks good. ensure the cost watch runs: `/billing watch --region us --threshold +20% --window 30m`
trent: billing watch set. moving on to first gate.
deploy-bot: progress update: region=us percent=2 steady. next check in 15m.
ash: telemetry to monitor: /dash/latency/us-v3, /dash/kvcache/us, /dash/gpu/thermal/us-pool-1
lina: ping for logs collection: enable debug sampling at 1/1000 for model-infer path during this rollout.
trent: 18m mark: US p95 +18ms, errors 0.15%, cache_hit 90%. advancing to 10% as planned. `/deploy bump --id act-7c3 --pct 10`
deploy-bot: bump accepted. now at 10% for region=us.
opsbot: after bump: us-pool-1 cpu=75% spare=15% queue_len=4. no pod restarts.
nina: still ok but thermal creeping +3C. add a soft-throttle if temps >78C.
ash: note: EU warm pool currently running infer-backfill jobs; recommend draining 1 node before EU rollout to reserve headroom.
trent: scheduled EU drain 30m prior to EU window. lina, can you coordinate?
lina: will do. ETA for drain completion: 02:50 UTC. posting update to #infra-ops.
ash: APAC risk: long-tail latencies during local peak (~08:15 SGT). For APAC planned window, start later in the window to avoid the sharp spike.
trent: we'll shift APAC start +20m to 08:20 SGT. documenting in change window notes.
deploy-bot: US rollout automation log: 2% -> 10% -> monitoring. action id=act-7c3.
trent: 35m US stable, proceed 30% step. `/deploy bump --id act-7c3 --pct 30`
deploy-bot: accepted. now at 30%.
opsbot: post-bump health: cpu=83% spare=7%, queue=6, gpu_temp=76C, cache_hit=88%
nina: CPU getting close to threshold. hold further increases for 10m and watch for sustained queuing.
trent: hold acknowledged. moving EU preflight now. `/deploy preflight --region eu --version v3.0.0-alpha --reserve 2nodes --drain-at 02:50`
deploy-bot: EU preflight scheduled and reserve requested.
lina: EU drain complete at 02:51 UTC. reserved nodes are tagged eu-reserve-3.
ash: run smoke canary in EU at 2% for 10m first; metrics to mirror US gates.
trent: starting EU canary now. `/deploy start --region eu --version v3.0.0-alpha --pct 2 --gate 10m`
deploy-bot: EU action id=act-9d1 started.
opsbot: EU preflight health: eu-pool cpu=70% spare=16% cache_hit=86% gpu_temp=69C
ash: EU 10m checkpoint: p95 +8ms, errors 0.05%, cache_hit 85% (just meets warmup gate). bump to 10% allowed.
trent: bumping EU to 10%: `/deploy bump --id act-9d1 --pct 10`
deploy-bot: EU now 10%.
trent: APAC will start at adjusted time. kicking off a pre-warm: `/deploy warmup --region apac --version v3.0.0-alpha --duration 5m --cache-prime`
opsbot: APAC warmup success: cache_hit increased from 62% -> 88% across slot groups. reserved spare nodes remaining ~12%.
nash: APAC safety note: set rollback pin target version to v2.9.8 (last known stable) instead of v3.0.0-beta to avoid mismatched configs.
lina: pin command ready: `/deploy pin --region apac --version v2.9.8 --reason "safe-fallback" --manual-only false`
trent: starting APAC canary at 2% now: `/deploy start --region apac --version v3.0.0-alpha --pct 2 --gate 15m`
deploy-bot: APAC action id=act-b4f initiated. monitor channels: #pager and #infra-alerts.
opsbot: apac initial health: avg_cpu=71% spare=12% cache_hit=88% gpu_temp=74C queue=3
nina: 10m APAC check: p95 +40ms, errors 0.2%, cache_hit steady. advance to 10% after 15m if trend holds.
trent: final note: release notes drafted and posted to #release-notes: "v3.0.0-alpha: kernel combos & batching improvements; staged region rollout US/EU/APAC; see changelog link: https://intra/release/v3.0.0-alpha"
ash: agreed follow-ups: 1) tune auto-throttle by region 2) make cache-prime step mandatory for kernel-switch rollouts 3) document fallback version mapping per region.
lina: will create tickets and link to release checklist. closing thread once all bumps complete or if any rollback occurs. :rocket:
